about: docs/MEDIA.md describes this file. Put each file beside it and list it under its slot.

slots.title: Twenty Yalms Ahead
slots.caption: /wayfinder test in an open field: the bead dim and close, the glove above it pointing on, the distance under it.

slots.title: The Glove Swings Round
slots.caption: Turning the character away: the bead brightens and the glove slides to the screen edge, pointing back, with its little tap.

slots.title: To the Flag
slots.caption: A map flag placed across a zone, then the walk to it with the trail on, ending in the arrival ring.

slots.title: The Next Step
slots.caption: A tracked quest with its marker on the map, and the pointer following it with no flag set.

slots.title: Teleport To
slots.caption: A flag in another zone: no arrow, only the note naming the aetheryte nearest it.

slots.title: The Wind-up Cursor Points
slots.caption: /wayfinder minion: the Wind-up Cursor model floating beside the bead, turning to point along the way and tilting up a slope.

slots.title: Along the Path, Not the Crow
slots.caption: With vnavmesh, the trail's beads laid along the walkable route around a wall, dropping away behind as the character walks it.
